pcs.pc_description: understand buyers defined and implied requirements for design quality and product colour conformity
collect all information needed for identification of threads for knotting and tufting e.g. material types, count, ply, shade number, design reference number etc
check the colour and/or indicative number along with the colour marked on design map
identify and highlight constraints affecting planning, production, quality and target delivery
ensure threads available are matching with the shade indicated on design map
check availability of threads in sufficient quantity as per design needs
supervise by patrolling and random checking to ensure threads are used as per design for knotting and tufting
check knots/inch2 and tuft density as per design indicated
process flow of department with stages and significance of monitoring needs for productivity and design conformity to quality.
